Confirmed finding: Dashboard quick search omits learner notes; the Search tab includes them. The same query can return different results.
Proposed correction: Use one shared search index and matching function, retaining role visibility.

Confirmed finding: The prototype includes legacy remedial-category records under Certifiable Skill. Only Subjects currently normalises remedial to cert; other category filters/groups compare raw category IDs.
Proposed correction: Use consistent category membership across filters, cards, groups and counts. Preserve the underlying attempt and parent IDs.
Source: HTML catIn; AdminLogbookCategories.jsx; AdminStudentEntryGroups.jsx; AdminLogbookPage.jsx filters

Confirmed finding: Student detail retains a selected subject, but Assign entry passes only student ID; the drawer defaults to the first actor department. A multi-department reviewer can assign in the wrong subject.
Proposed correction: Pass and validate the selected subject into the assignment drawer; retain student and subject together.

Confirmed finding: The pending-work warning now appears only for Ready/Returned. A legacy or externally changed Submitted logbook with pending work has no advance warning, although approval is blocked by the service. The HTML screenshot explicitly shows this warning.
Proposed correction: Show outstanding-work counts for Submitted too, explain why approval is unavailable and offer the allowed return/review path. Do not allow new work during submission.
Source: LogbookSignoff.jsx eligibility message; adminLogbook.js approval guard; HTML soD.pendingWarn

Confirmed finding: Each approval-chain step lacks a separate approver role, signature/return date and step-specific remarks. The data is partly in history but not presented beside the step.
Proposed correction: Render role, current-round decision date and remarks per approver; keep historical rounds separate.

Confirmed finding: The prototype displays step X of Y. Current lists show the current approver but no numeric chain position.
Proposed correction: Show current step and chain length for Submitted records, and state-appropriate text for Ready/Returned/Completed.
Source: HTML soRow; LogbookSignoff.jsx statusLabel and list rows

Confirmed finding: The four separate summaries in the screenshot are not reproduced: entries, approved, skills certified and requirements met. The first three exist as prose; category detail exists, but aggregate requirements-met count is absent.
Proposed correction: Add a compact four-value summary using existing computations. Label category coverage as logged requirements, not certification.
Source: HTML soD.tiles; LogbookSignoff.jsx rows, req and skills

Confirmed finding: Overall queue summary lacks affected-student count and overdue count; student group headers lack longest waiting time. The HTML has both summary and per-student waiting information.
Proposed correction: Add totals and per-student oldest wait from the same filtered records. Retain oldest-first ordering and graded-skill exclusions.

Confirmed finding: KPI cards omit the prototype supporting figures: affected students, longest wait, total approved skill attempts, and overdue assignment count.
Proposed correction: Restore useful supporting lines using the current metric definitions and the same drill-down datasets.

Confirmed finding: Needs attention is calculated, but student cards/details do not explicitly state why a learner is at risk. Prototype studentSummary exposes reason and reasonSentence.
Proposed correction: Expose calculated reasons such as low logged coverage or unresolved returned work, alongside existing counts.

Confirmed finding: The planned chain and ready-by/date are not visible directly in the readiness section before opening approval details; before marking Ready, the chain cannot be reviewed there.
Proposed correction: Show the configured chain before marking Ready and readiness attribution afterwards. Keep faculty judgement unchanged.

Confirmed finding: The HTML puts remedial students first and exposes pending state. Current expanded skill students stay in roster order and generic In progress conceals whether attempts are pending.
Proposed correction: Order remedial/awaiting-review learners first and show pending-attempt counts, with certified/not-started states distinct.
Source: HTML fSkillRows students; AdminLogbookSkills.jsx people rendering

Confirmed finding: Opening a student from a skill loses subject and competency context. Both the current app and prototype have this limitation.
Proposed correction: Carry the selected subject and skill to the student review and provide a return path. Treat this as a workflow enhancement, not a prototype omission.

Confirmed finding: The model has registerId, but several lists, searches and drawers display studentId instead. The prototype has distinct internal ID and roll number. Current sample values happen to match.
Proposed correction: Display/search registerId with studentId as fallback; retain internal IDs exclusively for record identity. Supply real register IDs through the roster integration.

Confirmed finding: Unlike the improved sign-off return flow, individual entry review still attempts the service call before reporting missing feedback or grading selections.
Proposed correction: Validate attempt, rating and return feedback next to their fields before invoking review. Preserve service-side checks.
Source: FacultyReview.jsx run and action handlers; adminLogbook.js reviewEntries

Confirmed finding: Subject detail omits the phase and faculty-member total visible in the prototype header. Category navigation and activity/attempt grouping are already restored.
Proposed correction: Add phase and faculty count using the current catalogue and reviewer memberships, without changing the header style.

Confirmed finding: Entry decision history is present, including earlier decisions and feedback. It has no subject/student/date/decision filtering. This is an enhancement, not a confirmed missing prototype control.
Proposed correction: Add compact filters only if desired; keep entry decisions separate from final sign-off history.

Confirmed finding: Several tabs rely on the shared Admin logbook hero without the prototype-specific visible title and scope summary, notably Queue and Students.
Proposed correction: Add compact tab titles and context within existing content cards; preserve the common hero and navigation.
Source: HTML Approval queue/Students headings; AdminLogbookPage.jsx and AdminLogbookStudents.jsx
